collection.description: A child hides from an afternoon chore to finish a game.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) hides from an afternoon chore to finish a game.

choices.label: Set a Firm but Fair Limit

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) argues about the workload, prompting a smaller assignment.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Working side by side turns the chore into a pleasant conversation.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) grows frustrated by constant guidance and asks to work alone.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (child) returns at the agreed time and completes the task.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) forgets, and (adult) calmly revisits the agreement.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) finishes reluctantly and later appreciates the clear expectation.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (adult) realizes the task was too large and adjusts it.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: (child) finishes and returns to play feeling proud.
